questions.question: How many real-time settlement intervals at ERCOT's West hub (HB_WEST) had a negative price in 2025?
questions.answer: HB_WEST had 2,724 real-time 15-minute settlement intervals at or below zero in 2025 (ercot_peak_premium_annual, variable n_negative, derived table). That count is out of 35,040 intervals, which is the full year. The table defines n_negative as intervals with price <= 0, so it includes intervals priced at exactly zero. It does not give a strictly negative count. The year is the ERCOT operating year in Central time.

questions.question: Measured as its demand less its own generation (the balance), how much electricity did the California ISO import on net in August 2026, in MWh?
questions.answer: On the balance measure (demand less the BA's own net generation), the California ISO imported 4,981,715 MWh net in August 2026 (ba_supply_monthly, entity eia930:CISO, variable net_import_balance_mwh). The row covers all 31 days of the month, with 0 days left out. That is 19.6606 percent of CAISO demand. This is a derived table. The summed pair flows give a lower figure, 2,101,695 MWh. The table's method note says CAISO's balance reads about 10 points higher than its flows from December 2025. The cause is that EIA's published net generation for CAISO dropped then. The month is Pacific-agnostic as the table labels it: 1 August 2026.

questions.question: In Berkeley Lab's queue data, of the capacity that entered ERCOT's interconnection queue in 2019, how many MW are now operating?
questions.answer: In Berkeley Lab's Queued Up 2026 edition (lbnl_interconnection_queue, source tier), ERCOT projects that entered the queue in 2019 and now have status operating total 9,451.88 MW across 64 projects. The other 2019 entries are still active (11,592.93 MW), suspended (1,825.15 MW) or withdrawn (20,687.75 MW). I identified the 2019 entries by the table's q_year value of 2019 and the ERCOT ones by region ERCOT. The MW figure is the sum of capacity_mw.

questions.question: How many of the public large-load statements the warehouse records are at the stage of a signed service agreement?
questions.answer: 27 of the 341 large-load statements in large_load_public are at the stage "4 signed service agreement". Of those 27, 25 are rows of kind mw and 2 are rows of kind wait. This table is model-extracted, meaning a model wrote at least one field, and it is public. The status and stage_class columns give the same count of 27. By status, the 341 rows split into 49 at request or inquiry, 52 at study or engineering, 2 at financial commitment, 27 at signed service agreement, 34 at under construction or energized, and 177 not classed. Counts are of statement rows as of the table's last run on 2026-10-14.
